US-001.title: View beaches on a real map

US-002.title: Interact with the map using pan and zoom

US-003.title: Select a beach via map marker

US-004.title: View the map in dark mode

AC-001.description: When the Discover page loads, the map shall render showing Vancouver's real coastline with all 9 beach markers visible at the default zoom level

AC-002.description: The map shall display recognizable geographic features (Stanley Park, English Bay, False Creek) that match real-world geography

AC-003.description: While the map is displayed, the map tiles shall load from OpenStreetMap without requiring any API key or user authentication

AC-004.description: When the user scrolls the mouse wheel over the map, the map shall zoom in or out centered on the cursor position

AC-005.description: When the user clicks and drags the map on desktop, the map shall pan in the direction of the drag

AC-006.description: When the user pinches on a touch device, the map shall zoom in or out accordingly

AC-007.description: When the user touch-drags on mobile, the map shall pan in the direction of the drag

AC-008.description: The map shall constrain zoom and pan to keep the Vancouver coastal area within reasonable bounds

AC-009.description: When the user clicks a beach marker, the system shall invoke the onSelectBeach callback if provided, or navigate to /beach/{beachId}

AC-010.description: When a beach is selected (via selectedBeachId prop), the corresponding marker shall display in a visually distinct selected state

AC-011.description: When the user hovers over a beach marker on desktop, a tooltip shall appear showing the beach name

AC-012.description: When a beach is marked as a favorite, its marker shall display a distinct favorite visual indicator

AC-013.description: When the application is in dark mode, the map container and surrounding UI shall match the dark theme

AC-014.description: The map tiles or map container styling shall not create a jarring bright contrast when dark mode is active

ADR-001.title: Use Leaflet with OpenStreetMap for interactive beach map
ADR-001.rationale: No API key needed for static Cloudflare Pages deployment, zero cost at any scale, smallest bundle size, sufficient for 9 markers

non_goals: NG-001: Adding new beaches or modifying existing beach dataset
NG-002: Implementing user geolocation or find nearest beach
NG-003: Adding directions or routing functionality
NG-004: Adding map layer controls (satellite, terrain)
NG-005: Modifying Discover page layout beyond map section
NG-007: Custom error handling for tile load failures
